spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶1:**

When the Divine Proceeding descended into the created order, it brought with it three degrees of external truth by which to operate: truth of rational understanding, truth animated by the good of love, and truth in the natural degree. It clothed itself in these from [GAP-1] it has [GAP-2] within them — in those three degrees of external truth [GAP-3] — it established [GAP-4] order governing all things of the created realm, both in the spiritual world and in the natural world. It set them in divine arrangement within the [GAP-5] through which it was made manifest. Afterwards [GAP-6] its operations [GAP-7] the [GAP-8] it divested itself of these external truths in the presence of those who were in states of genuine good.

---

**¶2:**

Now, when the Divine Proceeding was about to release [GAP-9] it removed these external truths from their point of conjunction, and it [GAP-10] within them — and thus these three degrees of external truth are arranged [GAP-11] from beneath the outermost limits of the containing spiritual order, as they encompass all that is within [GAP-12] ascending [GAP-13] toward higher states [GAP-14] ascending [GAP-15] — that which is above them strips away the containing order from that place at its inmost degree; and it is set below them and elevated back to the celestial states above, from which it had first proceeded at their origin.

---

**Note on the final movement:** The "zone" — the outermost encompassing boundary of external order — is removed at its highest point and returned upward. This corresponds to the principle that external truths, having served their use of clothing and protecting interior states during the work of ordering creation, are at last laid aside and reascend to their divine origin. What was outermost becomes transparent; the interior good from which all truth proceeded stands revealed. The stripping of the zone before the righteous is the unveiling of the Lord's interior divine love before those who have been regenerated — those for whom external truths are no longer needed as veils, because their interiors are open to receive the Divine directly.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: that when the Living Spirit came he brought the three garments; that of wind, that of fire, and that of water. He assumed them from [the heights] he has [clothed himself] in them in those three garments [and] he established [them] for all the things of [this univers]e, both above and below. He arranged them in the [form in which] he was displayed. Afterwards [he finished] his works [of] the [world]e stripped them off before [the ri]ghteous ones.

Now, when he was about to loose [and then] divested himself of them from their (clasp) and he [set all things]n them, and thus these three g[arme]nts are arranged [and extend] from below the edges of the zone as they clothe i[t al]l [and reach] up [to the heights] above [and from there] up [to that which is] above them strips them of the zone from that place at its topmost point; and it is placed below them and ra[ised u]p to the heights above, from which it had been sent o[u]t at their beginning.

fills.explanation: The Living Spirit assumed the garments from the divine origin above, and the text's closing line confirms this source: "the heights above, from which it had been sent out at their beginning."
The spiritual reading indicates the Divine clothed itself within the three degrees of external truth, and "clothed himself" is the standard Kephalaia expression for assuming garments.
The spiritual reading shows a clause break (marked by a dash) between the garment description and the establishing action, requiring a simple conjunction to connect the two paratactic clauses.

The editor's "them" is confirmed: in the natural register, the Living Spirit established the garments as the ordering framework for the universe, which the spiritual reading expands as "established order governing all things."

The spiritual reading says the Divine was made manifest "through" something; "form" (morphe) is standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary for the visible manifestation through which a divine power is displayed.

The spiritual reading indicates the Divine completed its operations before divesting the external truths; "he finished his works" is the natural-plane expression for this completion in the Kephalaia register.
The phrase "his works of the world" is a standard Kephalaia construction describing the Living Spirit's creative operations pertaining to the cosmos.

The Living Spirit finished his works of the world (cosmos) before stripping off the garments; "world" is the standard Kephalaia term for the created realm in which the divine operations were performed.

The spiritual reading shows a simple temporal transition from the act of releasing to the act of removing; "and then" bridges "loosen them" to "he divested himself" in natural Kephalaia paratactic style.

After divesting the garments from his person, the Living Spirit set all things of the cosmos within them, making the garments into cosmic structures — as confirmed by the next clause describing the garments arranged as cosmic coverings.

The garments, once arranged as cosmic structures, extend spatially from below the zone upward; "extend" captures the spatial reaching described in the spiritual reading's "from beneath the outermost limits."
The garments clothe everything and reach upward, continuing the ascending spatial progression described in the spiritual reading as "ascending" from the encompassed interior.
The upward movement reaches "the heights above," mirroring the text's closing reference to "the heights above" as the divine origin; this matches the spiritual reading's "toward higher states."

The spatial progression continues from the heights above to an even higher point; "and from there" provides the locative transition needed between the two ascending movements in the Kephalaia's concrete spatial register.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "that which is above them strips away the containing order," making "that which is" the necessary relative clause introducing the supreme agent (the divine above all garments) that performs the stripping of the zone.
